# Exam preparation

Own `ExamPreparationPlan` and an evidence-bounded readiness report. Work directly for one exam or hand off a plan to the orchestrator for coordinated curriculum, diagnostic, material, mock and tutoring work. Use `references/education/contracts.json` when bundled. Without it, keep the same fields in a versioned editable plan and mark machine validation unavailable.

## Inputs and outputs

Establish exact exam name, authority, jurisdiction, session or year, target date, syllabus edition, format, permitted aids, scoring rules, learner goals, available hours, current evidence and language. Verify official format, dates, syllabus, eligibility and scoring from the issuing authority before asserting current facts. Supplied or cached sources can support a provisional plan offline, with version and verification status visible.

## Procedure

1. Map the official syllabus and format to requirement IDs. Identify unverified or changed specifications and pause claims of official alignment until checked. Do not infer equivalence between countries or providers.
2. Use observed diagnostic evidence when available. Where it is absent, plan an initial diagnostic rather than inventing a learner profile. Distinguish content gaps, exam technique, administration and constraints.
3. Work backward from the date and available time. Build a calendar with dated or week-indexed sessions, estimated hours, prerequisite work, essential coverage, revision, timed practice, error analysis and rest. Reserve explicit recovery sessions for missed work, and say which lower-priority tasks move first if time is lost. Never compress all missed content into the last week. Name which milestones depend on unverified evidence.
4. Request materials, assessment items and unofficial mock specifications from their owners when needed. Put solutions and scoring apart from learner-facing practice. Use feedback and spaced retrieval when conditions fit the rule IDs in `references/education/evidence.json`.
5. Report readiness using observed coverage and performance by objective, conditions and assistance level. State what remains unknown. One mock result does not establish admission probability.

Record a changed official specification as a new source edition and invalidate dependent blueprint, mock and timetable assumptions. A deadline that cannot be verified remains unknown. Do not offer help during a live exam when that would violate its rules.

For a six-week plan with six study hours weekly, a provisional allocation could use four hours for current content and two for review, practice or recovery. The actual allocation follows verified scope and diagnostic gaps. Each week records planned and completed sessions. If a session is missed, use the next recovery slot, recalculate remaining hours and re-rank uncovered essentials before changing the target date or claiming readiness.

## Checks and examples

A request for a six-week university admission mathematics plan activates this skill. A request to explain one quadratic equation without exam context belongs to instructional design or tutoring. For a provisional plan with no official syllabus, identify the assumed topics and state what official verification would change. In orchestration, return source version, prioritized requirement IDs, milestones and readiness limits.
